report: Source review: the complete claim requires class-qualified invokes to permit the named class and known subclasses, independently of caller receiver identity. Both ordinary implementation entries satisfy this: validate.rs resolves the named method, includes descendants through ancestors/method lookup, and marks only self-rooted permissions same_receiver; contracts.rs accepts any matching unrestricted permission before receiver comparison. Both ordinary associated tests were inspected. a_class_wide_permission_does_not_require_receiver_identity calls Item::read with missing and unequal identities, alongside a self permission, and asserts calls_conform (which checks both violations and gaps). overrides_inherit_prohibitions_and_calls_dispatch_to_known_implementations calls Child::run under Base::run permission: its exact two-violation count and inherited-rule assertion account for the undeclared Leaf edge and inherited prohibition, leaving no extra undeclared Child edge. This meaningfully exercises known-subclass permission. Captured runtime test setup helpers parse a demo model and establish explicit roots. No TODO/N/A entries or deferred prerequisites exist. Baseline: independently verified exact byte equality of contracts.rs, validate.rs, and runtime_contracts.rs with the supplied historical snapshots; the earlier rationale remains supported by current source and full associated assertions. Execution: personally ran review start/read and byte comparison, then review record; no behavioral tests or build were run by this reviewer. The coordinator separately reports 321 passing functional tests and a passing root build. No source edits requested.
